tools.name: virtual_staging
tools.description: AI virtual staging: furnish and style an empty (or badly furnished) room photo in a chosen interior design style — also the tool for "redesign this room" or "show this room in another style". HD, watermark-free results. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: edit_staged_photo
tools.description: Change one thing in a photo and keep everything else exactly as it is — the parts the edit doesn't touch are copied from the photo, not redrawn. Works on any photo: a staged room, any Pixly result, or the user's own picture (swap the sofa, recolour a wall, remove a car, change the words on a sign).

tools.name: cinematic_motion
tools.description: Photo to video: turn a single listing photo into a short cinematic real estate video with a professional camera move (zoom, orbit, fly-through, crane up…). No second frame needed. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: photo_to_video
tools.description: Turn a start photo — and optionally an end photo — into a video. With an end photo the camera travels from the first photo and lands exactly on the second (e.g. two views of the same kitchen → an orbit around the island). tools.description: Flythrough video: one continuous camera move through a home from 2-4 room photos in walking order. tools.name: watermark_photos
tools.description: Free (no credits): put the agent's or agency's mark on listing photos — text (name, phone) and/or the logo saved on their Pixly account — in a corner or the middle, up to 10 photos per call. Returns every marked photo at once.

tools.name: blur_faces_plates
tools.description: Free (no credits): find and blur people's faces and car licence plates in property photos before they're posted — street and exterior shots, open houses. Automatic detection, 1–5 photos per call. Says so when nothing is found.

tools.name: straighten_photo
tools.description: Free (no credits): automatically straighten a property photo — leaning walls made vertical (converging verticals from a tilted camera) and a tilted horizon levelled, like a pro photographer's lens correction. Crops the edges slightly. Best before staging or any other edit. Says so when the photo is

tools.description: Free (no credits): draw a clean 2D floor plan from a layout YOU write — read the user's description, or look at their hand sketch or brochure plan, and send every room as a rectangle in metres (or feet) plus doors and windows. Returns the drawn plan (areas and dimensions on it) at once, saved so the

tools.name: enhance_photo
tools.description: Real estate photo editing in one step: turn an amateur listing photo into a finished, professional photo (exposure, color, clarity). Returns 3 variants to pick from. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: declutter_photo
tools.description: Remove clutter, mess, and personal items from a listing photo while keeping the room, furniture, and architecture intact. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: remove_furniture
tools.description: Remove furniture from a photo: empty a room and rebuild the surfaces behind what was taken out, keeping the architecture and camera angle identical — the blank canvas for restaging. By default it also removes the room's own joinery (fitted kitchen, built-in wardrobes, bathroom fixtures); mode 'movab

tools.name: day_to_night
tools.description: Day to dusk (virtual twilight): turn a daytime listing photo into a magazine-style evening scene — lights on, warm glow, dusk sky — with the building and camera angle unchanged. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: replace_sky
tools.description: Replace a grey, overcast or blown-out sky in an exterior listing photo with a natural clear blue sky, matching the light and keeping the building, trees and reflections unchanged. A run takes about 1–2 minutes; poll get_job until it completes. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: replace_lawn
tools.description: Turn patchy, brown or bare grass in an exterior listing photo into a healthy green lawn, leaving driveways, paths, beds and the house untouched. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: restyle_room
tools.description: Give one or more surfaces of a room a new finish — repaint the walls, change the floor, reface the kitchen cabinets and worktop, retile the bathroom or refinish the furniture — while the room's layout, fittings, windows and camera angle stay exactly as shot. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balan

tools.name: reset_season
tools.description: Photograph the same property in another season: take the snow off the ground, the roof and the branches and put the garden in leaf, or move a summer shot to autumn or winter. The house, the driveway, the paths and the camera angle stay exactly as shot. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: makeover_exterior
tools.description: Design the garden of an exterior listing photo as one coherent scheme — planting, a terrace or deck, a pool, a pergola, a fire pit, a fence, lighting — in a chosen style, at the right scale and perspective, while the house, its roof, the driveway, the sun direction and the neighbours stay exactly as

tools.name: render_floor_plan
tools.description: Turn a picture of any floor plan — a hand sketch, a photo of a brochure page, a blueprint, a screenshot — into a polished real-estate floor plan: a furnished top-down 2D plan with real floors and room names, or a 3D isometric cutaway. The rooms, walls, doors and windows are kept exactly as drawn; no

tools.name: touch_up_exterior
tools.description: One-click retouch of an exterior listing photo: a natural sky where it is dull, a healthy lawn where the grass is dead, a clean driveway, and bins, hoses and other clutter removed — each only where needed, with the house unchanged. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: upscale_hd
tools.description: Enlarge a photo by up to four times with real detail, to a maximum of 4096 px on the long edge — for print, MLS uploads and large screens. Nothing in the photo changes. Free on any result Pixly made (pass its r2Path from list_library); 1 credit on your own photo. Costs credits from the user's Pixly

tools.name: plot_sign
tools.description: Place a photorealistic 3D monument sign with your exact text (price, area, SOLD) onto a photo of an empty plot, matched to perspective and lighting. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

tools.name: upload_image_from_url
tools.description: Rarely needed: generation tools take an imageUrl directly. Use this only to import a photo into Pixly ahead of time, e.g. to reuse one URL across several tools without refetching it each time.

tools.name: create_upload_ticket
tools.description: Get a presigned upload URL for a LOCAL image file — the one case a URL can't cover. PUT the file to uploadUrl with the same Content-Type, then pass the returned r2Path to a generation tool instead of imageUrl. Ticket expires in 1 hour.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Check a generation job's status and fetch result URLs when it's done. Video jobs take 1-5 minutes — poll this with a few seconds between calls. For several jobs at once (a plan's steps), pass jobIds.

tools.name: list_library
tools.description: List the user's recent generations, or with type "uploads" their own uploaded source photos, newest first. Uploads are the way in when the photo is a local file: connectors cannot send bytes, so the user adds it at https://pixly.app/app and you pick up the r2Path here.

tools.name: view_pixly_photo
tools.description: Look at one of the user's Pixly photos or videos (a video gives its first frame) — returns a small copy of the picture you can see. Use it before writing anything about a Pixly result: a caption, a listing description, what changed. You cannot see Pixly results otherwise. Free; changes nothing. Text

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: The user's current Pixly credit balance and plan.

tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: The user's property folders (a listing such as "12 Oak St" holds that property's photos, staged versions, edits, videos and floor plan): id, title, how many photos and videos. Use when the user names a property, or before work for one, so results land in its folder.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a property folder before work on a whole property (a set of listing photos, a walkthrough). Ask the user once which property it is and pass that as title; if they skip, leave title out. Pass the returned listingId to the tools so their results land in it. Costs nothing.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Rename one of the user's property folders, only when they ask.

tools.name: plan_photos
tools.description: Several listing photos at once: one plan of photo steps (straighten, enhance, sky, lawn, staging, declutter…) with one total and one confirmation, instead of a confirm per photo. The first call runs nothing: it returns each step's cost, the total and a confirmationCode, and the Pixly card shows the

tools.description: Use when a tool fails for lack of credits or a plan. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the user to pay on — this never charges anything by itself, and you cannot pay for them. With no active plan it is a subscription (plans: starter (Starter: $5.99/week, 20 credits); agent (Agent: $19.99/month, 100

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_upload_ticket, get_job, view_pixly_photo, get_checkout_link · Private data: create_upload_ticket, list_library · Public sink: draw_floor_plan, upload_image_from_url, create_upload_ticket, list_library, view_pixly_photo · Destructive: edit_staged_photo, declutter_photo, remove_furniture, replace_sky, reset_season, makeover_exterior, get_checkout_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_upload_ticket, get_job, view_pixly_photo, get_checkout_link · Private data: create_upload_ticket, list_library · Public sink: draw_floor_plan, upload_image_from_url, create_upload_ticket, list_library, view_pixly_photo · Destructive: edit_staged_photo, declutter_photo, remove_furniture, replace_sky, reset_season, makeover_exterior, get_checkout_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

evidence.snippet: before: "Turn a daytime listing photo into a magazine-style night scene — lights on, warm glow, dusk sky — with the building and camera angle unchanged. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance." → after: "Day to dusk (virtual twilight): turn a daytime listing photo into a magazine-style evening scene — lights on, warm glow, dusk sky — with the building and camera angle unchanged. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "replace_sky" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

A run takes about 1–2 minutes; poll get_job until it completes. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance."
